sheets.name: L3-AuthAPI
sheets.title: L3-AuthAPI  |  /auth/login, /auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout, /auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password, /user/first-login  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-AUTH-01.notes: Real Tomcat + real login: the token is signed by JwtTokenServiceImpl and later verified by NimbusJwtDecoder
L3-AUTH-01.block: Block: POST /api/v1/auth/login  |  Input dimensions: credentials, account status, body validation

L3-AUTH-02.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, message "Dữ liệu không hợp lệ"\ndetails[] names both employeeCode and password
L3-AUTH-02.notes: Bean validation answers 422, not the conventional 400 — same across the whole API

L3-AUTH-03.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Mã nhân viên hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác"
L3-AUTH-03.notes: Contract divergence: credentials failure is BadRequestException → 400 REQ_001, while the TDS 8.1 registry implies AUTH_001

L3-AUTH-04.responseBody: error_code REQ_001 with the identical message to a wrong password — the response does not reveal whether the account exists
L3-AUTH-04.notes: Good: no account enumeration here (contrast with L3-AUTH-12)

L3-AUTH-05.responseBody: error_code AUTH_001, message "Tài khoản đã bị khóa"\nno tokens issued

L3-AUTH-06.responseBody: data.employeeCode = caller's code\ndata.id = caller's user id
L3-AUTH-06.notes: Proves NimbusJwtDecoder HS256 verification + CustomJwtAuthenticationConverter — the part MockMvc's jwt() post-processor bypasses
L3-AUTH-06.block: Block: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh-token, /auth/logout  |  Input dimensions: token validity, revocation, replay

L3-AUTH-07.responseBody: data.accessToken is new and authenticates GET /me → 200\ndata.refreshToken unchanged (no rotation, D25)

L3-AUTH-08.responseBody: error_code AUTH_001, message "Refresh token không hợp lệ"

L3-AUTH-09.responseBody: error_code AUTH_001, message "Token đã bị thu hồi"\nDB: refresh_tokens.revoked = true

L3-AUTH-10.responseBody: both calls 200; the row stays revoked = true
L3-AUTH-10.notes: Logout is one of the six permitAll matchers, so no access token is needed and replay is harmless

L3-AUTH-11.responseBody: DB: password_reset_otp row, 6 digits, used = false, expires in 5 min\nexactly one email queued to that address
L3-AUTH-11.notes: Email captured at the EmailProducer boundary (CapturingEmailProducerConfig) — no broker in the test profile
L3-AUTH-11.block: Block: POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password  |  Input dimensions: email existence, OTP state, password rules

L3-AUTH-12.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Không tìm thấy email"\nno email queued
L3-AUTH-12.notes: D39: the distinct message lets an attacker enumerate registered emails — unlike the login path, which stays uniform

L3-AUTH-13.responseBody: DB: OTP row used = true\nlogin with the new password → 200
L3-AUTH-13.notes: Password and OTP flip in the same transaction

L3-AUTH-14.request: the same body replayed after a successful reset
L3-AUTH-14.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Mã OTP đã được sử dụng"

L3-AUTH-15.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] names newPassword (@Size min 4)
L3-AUTH-15.notes: Validation runs before the OTP lookup, so a wrong OTP is never reported here

L3-AUTH-16.responseBody: EMPTY body — no error_code, no message, no correlation_id\nWWW-Authenticate: Bearer\nno X-Correlation-ID header
L3-AUTH-16.notes: D36: SecurityConfig registers no authenticationEntryPoint, so BearerTokenAuthenticationEntryPoint answers before the dispatcher. /user/first-login/** is NOT in the permitAll list
L3-AUTH-16.block: Block: authentication entry point  |  Input dimension: missing token on a protected endpoint

sheets.name: L3-UserAdminAPI
sheets.title: L3-UserAdminAPI  |  /users, /me, /user/change-password, /users/{id}/lock, /departments  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-USR-01.responseBody: data.content[] present\ndata.pageable and data.numberOfElements present (Spring PageImpl)\ndata.page ABSENT
L3-USR-01.notes: D37: the only paginated endpoint that serialises Spring's Page instead of PageResponse — frontend must special-case it
L3-USR-01.block: Block: GET /api/v1/users  |  Input dimensions: paging, keyword filter, enum filter, auth

L3-USR-02.responseBody: data.content has exactly 1 item, content[0].employeeCode = the requested code

L3-USR-03.notes: A bad enum on a @ModelAttribute filter binds to 422 VAL_001; a bad enum on a plain @RequestParam is 400 REQ_001 — two different contracts in one API

L3-USR-04.responseBody: DB: users row created, email stored\none credentials email queued to the new address
L3-USR-04.block: Block: POST /api/v1/users  |  Input dimensions: required fields, uniqueness, role gate

L3-USR-05.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] names employeeCode and roleIds

L3-USR-06.responseBody: error_code SYS_409, message "Mã nhân viên đã tồn tại"
L3-USR-06.notes: The service checks uniqueness explicitly, so this is a clean 409 — unlike system_settings, where a raw unique violation surfaces as 500 (D30)

L3-USR-07.request: valid create body but a non-admin token
L3-USR-07.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002, message "Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này."\nuser count unchanged

L3-USR-08.responseBody: EMPTY body — the ErrorResponse envelope does not apply to authentication failures
L3-USR-08.notes: D36, same entry point as L3-AUTH-16

L3-USR-09.block: Block: GET /api/v1/user/{id}, PATCH /user/change-password  |  Input dimensions: existence, own credential

L3-USR-10.responseBody: login with the new password → 200 (the credential really rotated)

L3-USR-11.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Mật khẩu cũ không chính xác"

L3-USR-12.request: path: target user id, no body
L3-USR-12.responseBody: after lock: DB status = LOCKED and login → 401 AUTH_001\nafter unlock: login → 200
L3-USR-12.block: Block: account lifecycle  |  Input dimensions: lock state, soft delete, unknown id

L3-USR-13.responseBody: DB: is_deleted = true (row kept)\nlogin with that account → 400 REQ_001

L3-USR-15.responseBody: GET /departments then lists the new code
L3-USR-15.block: Block: reference data /departments  |  Input dimensions: create, role gate

L3-USR-16.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — the whole ReferenceDataController is ADMIN-only at class level

sheets.name: L3-TrainingAPI
sheets.title: L3-TrainingAPI  |  /training/records, /evidences, /training/employees/status, /training/status/me  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-TRN-01.responseBody: data = PageResponse { content, page = 0, size = 20, totalElements, totalPages, sort }\ndata.sort contains "updatedAt,desc"
L3-TRN-01.block: Block: GET /api/v1/training/records  |  Input dimensions: paging, sort whitelist

L3-TRN-02.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message names the rejected property ("Thuộc tính sắp xếp không được hỗ trợ: secretColumn")
L3-TRN-02.notes: Whitelist of sortable properties — also the defence tested by L3-SEC-06

L3-TRN-03.request: body: {activityTypeId, title, provider, startDate, endDate, durationValue, durationUnit:"HOUR", declaredHours}
L3-TRN-03.responseBody: data.workflowStatus = DRAFT, sourceType = MANUAL, editCount = 0, version = 0, submittedAt = null\ndata.employeeId = caller (a USER cannot create for someone else)
L3-TRN-03.notes: Create answers 200, not 201 — differs from POST /forms and POST /form-submissions in the same API
L3-TRN-03.block: Block: POST /api/v1/training/records  |  Input dimensions: required fields, boundaries, date order, ownership

L3-TRN-04.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] names all three fields

L3-TRN-05.notes: Boundary: 0.5 is the smallest accepted value

L3-TRN-06.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "End date must be greater than or equal to start date"
L3-TRN-06.notes: Domain validation answers 400 while bean validation answers 422 — both on the same endpoint

L3-TRN-07.request: path: a record owned by someone else
L3-TRN-07.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002, message "You do not have access to this training record"\nthe record's title is unchanged

L3-TRN-08.responseBody: data.workflowStatus = SUBMITTED, submittedAt set, version incremented
L3-TRN-08.block: Block: submit / return-to-draft state machine  |  Input dimensions: current status, actor role

L3-TRN-09.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Hồ sơ đào tạo ở trạng thái SUBMITTED không thể chỉnh sửa"
L3-TRN-09.notes: The editability guard runs before the state machine, so this is 400 REQ_001 rather than a 409 conflict

L3-TRN-10.notes: D15: the owner passes the ownership check but the transition is admin-only, so the owner can never withdraw a submission

L3-TRN-13.request: multipart part "file": evidence.png (real PNG bytes), Content-Type image/png
L3-TRN-13.responseBody: data.moderationStatus = PASSED, mimeType = image/png, storedChecksumSha256 non-blank, active = true
L3-TRN-13.notes: Storage is the in-memory test double (TestEvidenceStorageConfig, @Profile("test")); moderation is the local metadata-only checker
L3-TRN-13.block: Block: POST /training/records/{id}/evidences (+ download-url)  |  Input dimensions: mime/magic-byte agreement, size, presigned URL

L3-TRN-14.request: multipart part "file": PNG bytes named evidence.pdf, Content-Type application/pdf
L3-TRN-14.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] = "Evidence file content must match an allowed JPG, PNG, or PDF"
L3-TRN-14.notes: Magic bytes, declared Content-Type and extension must all agree; a missing part Content-Type produces the same message

L3-TRN-15.responseBody: data.downloadUrl starts with https://evidence.test/ and data.expiresAt is set (5-minute TTL)
L3-TRN-15.notes: On production this is a Cloudflare R2 presigned URL; the test profile swaps in the in-memory adapter

L3-TRN-16.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — the endpoint is ADMIN/MANAGER/SYSTEM_JOB only
L3-TRN-16.block: Block: compliance read model  |  Input dimensions: role gate, paging, own-status projection

L3-TRN-17.responseBody: data.sort contains "employeeCode,asc"\nrows expose requiredHours, submittedHours, complianceStatus

L3-TRN-18.request: no params; caller has one SUBMITTED record of 2 h and one DRAFT record
L3-TRN-18.responseBody: data.employeeId = caller\ndata.submittedHours = 2.0 (the DRAFT is not counted)\nrequiredHours and remainingHours present
L3-TRN-18.notes: requiredHours comes from the global system setting, not from a TrainingRequirement row

sheets.name: L3-QualityAPI
sheets.title: L3-QualityAPI  |  /forms, /versions, /publication, /form-assignments, /assigned-forms, /form-submissions  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-QLT-01.block: Block: GET /api/v1/forms  |  Input dimensions: paging cap, role gate

L3-QLT-02.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] names size ("Page size must be between 1 and 100")

L3-QLT-03.responseBody: Location header set\ndata.code trimmed and upper-cased, data.status = DRAFT
L3-QLT-03.notes: 201 + Location here, but POST /training/records answers 200 — the API is not consistent about creation status codes
L3-QLT-03.block: Block: POST /api/v1/forms  |  Input dimensions: code pattern, required fields, uniqueness

L3-QLT-04.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] names title, subjectType and code (pattern)

L3-QLT-05.responseBody: error_code SYS_409, message "Form code already exists"

L3-QLT-06.request: body: one section, one required SINGLE_CHOICE question, two scored options
L3-QLT-06.responseBody: data.versionNumber = 1, status = DRAFT, lockVersion issued, sections has 1 entry
L3-QLT-06.block: Block: form version lifecycle  |  Input dimensions: single-draft rule, publish validation, optimistic lock

L3-QLT-07.request: same body while a DRAFT already exists
L3-QLT-07.responseBody: error_code SYS_409, message "This form already has a draft version"

L3-QLT-08.responseBody: data.status = PUBLISHED, schemaHash non-blank, publishedAt set, publishedBy.employeeCode = caller\nGET /forms/{id}: status PUBLISHED, currentPublishedVersion.id = that version

L3-QLT-09.request: publishing a version created from an empty body (no sections)
L3-QLT-09.responseBody: error_code VAL_001, details[] = "A published form must contain at least one section"

L3-QLT-10.request: body replaying a lockVersion that a previous successful write already consumed
L3-QLT-10.responseBody: error_code SYS_409, message "Form version has been updated by another user"
L3-QLT-10.notes: Optimistic locking is exposed to the client as an explicit lockVersion token, not an ETag

L3-QLT-11.request: publish a second version of the same form
L3-QLT-11.notes: ACTIVE assignment items are re-pointed to v2 as part of the same transaction

L3-QLT-12.responseBody: empty body (no ApiResponse envelope)\nGET /forms/{id} → 404 SYS_404 (soft delete keeps the row)
L3-QLT-12.notes: 204 with no envelope is unique to this endpoint — every other write returns ApiResponse

L3-QLT-14.responseBody: data.items has 1 entry with assignmentItemId\nthe assignee's GET /assigned-forms lists that id
L3-QLT-14.notes: Targets are user ids only — no department or training-group targeting on this endpoint
L3-QLT-14.block: Block: assignment + submission round trip  |  Input dimensions: ownership scoping, answer validity, submit state

L3-QLT-15.request: path: an assignment item belonging to someone else
L3-QLT-15.responseBody: error_code SYS_404, message "Không tìm thấy biểu mẫu được phân công" — existence is hidden rather than reported as 403
L3-QLT-15.notes: Deliberate: 404 avoids confirming that the item exists. Note the inconsistency with training records, which answer 403

L3-QLT-16.responseBody: data.status = DRAFT, scoringStatus = NOT_CONFIGURED, assignmentItemId echoed

L3-QLT-17.request: answers: [{questionKey, optionKey}] with the current lockVersion; then {"lockVersion":N}
L3-QLT-17.responseBody: data.status = SUBMITTED, scoringStatus = CALCULATED, submittedAt set, criticalFailure = false, result present
L3-QLT-17.notes: Answers are keyed by UUID (questionKey/optionKey), not numeric ids; each write bumps lockVersion

L3-QLT-18.responseBody: error_code SYS_409, message "Only a draft submission can be modified"
L3-QLT-18.notes: The status guard runs before the lock check, so the message is about the draft state, not the stale token

L3-QLT-19.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — scoring configuration is ADMIN/MANAGER only

sheets.name: L3-ExamAPI
sheets.title: L3-ExamAPI  |  /questions, /question-sets, /exam-configs, /exam-papers, /exam-assignments, /me/exam-attempts  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-EXM-01.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — @evaluationSecurity.canAccess requires ADMIN or one of the 8 evaluation permissions
L3-EXM-01.block: Block: question bank  |  Input dimensions: evaluation permission matrix, required fields, review gate

L3-EXM-02.responseBody: data is a bare JSON array — no PageResponse envelope, capped at the newest 500 rows server-side
L3-EXM-02.notes: Several evaluation list endpoints share this shape (/question-sets, /exam-configs, /exam-papers, /exam-assignments)

L3-EXM-03.responseBody: data.status = APPROVED (not DRAFT), questionType = ORIGINAL, reviewedBy = the author
L3-EXM-03.notes: D41: the create path defaults to APPROVED, so QUESTION_AUTHOR alone publishes into the bank and the QUESTION_REVIEWER gate only applies to questions explicitly created as DRAFT

L3-EXM-06.request: path: a question created with status DRAFT

L3-EXM-07.responseBody: data.status = ACTIVE, questionCount = 1 (snapshot locked on activation)
L3-EXM-07.block: Block: question set + exam config  |  Input dimensions: emptiness, score scale, activation guards

L3-EXM-08.request: path: a set created with no questionIds
L3-EXM-08.responseBody: message "Không thể kích hoạt bộ câu hỏi rỗng"

L3-EXM-09.request: body: {name, questionSetId, totalQuestions:1, timeLimitMinutes:30, passingScore:7, maxRetakes:3, shuffle*:false}

L3-EXM-10.notes: Same family as D24: the SRS describes a 0–100 scale while the API enforces 0–10

L3-EXM-11.responseBody: generate: data is an array, one paper per variant\npublish: data.status = PUBLISHED, totalQuestions = 1
L3-EXM-11.notes: Generation is also what writes the question snapshots that grading later reads — there is no other API to create them
L3-EXM-11.block: Block: exam paper + assignment  |  Input dimensions: prerequisites, targeting, open/close

L3-EXM-12.request: body: {name, examPaperId, professionalFieldId, userIds:[N], maxAttempts:2, resultVisibility:"SCORE_AND_ANSWERS", status:"DRAFT"}
L3-EXM-12.notes: professionalFieldId is mandatory over HTTP even though the entity allows null

L3-EXM-13.responseBody: the assignment is listed for the targeted employee\nattempt: status IN_PROGRESS, attemptNumber 1, expiresAt = min(now + timeLimit, dueAt), questions has 1 entry
L3-EXM-13.block: Block: /me attempt lifecycle  |  Input dimensions: attempt quota, answer submission, ownership

L3-EXM-14.responseBody: data.status = GRADED (not SUBMITTED), correctCount = 1, score within 0–10, submittedAt set

L3-EXM-15.request: starting again after the single allowed attempt was submitted
L3-EXM-15.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Bạn đã dùng hết số lượt làm bài"

L3-EXM-16.request: path: an attempt owned by someone else
L3-EXM-16.responseBody: error_code REQ_001, message "Bạn không có quyền truy cập lượt làm bài này"
L3-EXM-16.notes: D40: an authorisation failure is reported as a bad request, so clients cannot distinguish it from malformed input — every other module answers 403 AUTH_002

sheets.name: L3-AnalyticsAPI
sheets.title: L3-AnalyticsAPI  |  /dashboard/*, /evaluation-dashboard, /competency, /me/notifications, /admin/system-settings  |  Input Domain Partitioning per endpoint

L3-ANL-01.responseBody: data.cacheTtlSeconds > 0, data.period present, data.users.total > 0, data.forms and data.submissions blocks present
L3-ANL-01.notes: Native SQL with ::numeric casts and count(*) filter (where …) — executed successfully by H2 in MODE=PostgreSQL, so no Blocked row was needed
L3-ANL-01.block: Block: admin dashboards  |  Input dimensions: role gate, period params, paging

L3-ANL-03.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — the /dashboard/users/* endpoints are ADMIN-only while /dashboard/forms/* also allow MANAGER

L3-ANL-05.responseBody: data.items is an array of { period, …, averageConvertedScore }
L3-ANL-05.notes: Uses date_trunc(… at time zone 'Asia/Bangkok') — H2 in PostgreSQL mode accepts it, but the bucket boundaries are only guaranteed on PostgreSQL

L3-ANL-06.request: optional params: fromDate, toDate, allTime, professionalFieldId
L3-ANL-06.responseBody: data.scope.departmentId = the caller's own department (a supplied departmentId is ignored)\ndata.training, data.theory, data.quality blocks present
L3-ANL-06.notes: theory.available is false unless the caller also holds RESULT_VIEWER or EXAM_PUBLISHER
L3-ANL-06.block: Block: manager + evaluation dashboards  |  Input dimensions: department scoping, permission gate

L3-ANL-08.notes: Pure JPA, so it behaves identically on H2 and PostgreSQL

L3-ANL-09.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002 — needs one of RESULT_VIEWER, QUESTION_REVIEWER, QUESTION_SET_MANAGER, EXAM_PUBLISHER

L3-ANL-10.request: params: departmentId = the caller's own department
L3-ANL-10.responseBody: data.items array plus data.page/size/totalElements flattened onto the DTO (size defaults to 10)
L3-ANL-10.notes: A third pagination shape in the same API: not PageResponse, not Spring's Page
L3-ANL-10.block: Block: competency read model  |  Input dimensions: department scoping, paging

L3-ANL-11.responseBody: error_code AUTH_002, message "Chỉ Admin được xem dữ liệu năng lực toàn viện"
L3-ANL-11.notes: Omitting the scope means hospital-wide, which is admin-only — a MANAGER must always pass their own departmentId

L3-ANL-12.responseBody: list: PageResponse with size 20\nunread-count: data.unreadCount is a number\nread-status: data is a bare integer (rows updated), not an object
L3-ANL-12.notes: Three different data shapes across three endpoints of the same controller
L3-ANL-12.block: Block: notifications + system settings  |  Input dimensions: response shape, validation floor, role gate

L3-ANL-13.responseBody: GET: data.globalTrainingHours > 0 and trainingWindowYears present\nPUT: error_code VAL_001, details[] names globalTrainingHours (@DecimalMin 0.5)\nGET with a USER token: 403 AUTH_002

L3-FLOW-01.expected:
After 1: 200, access token issued
After 2: 200, credential rotated
After 3: 400 REQ_001 "Mã nhân viên hoặc mật khẩu không chính xác"
After 4: 200 and GET /me returns the same employeeCode
L3-FLOW-01.notes: Confirms the rotation is atomic from the client's point of view — the old secret stops working immediately
L3-FLOW-01.block: FLOW-01: Credential rotation  |  login → change password → old fails, new works

L3-FLOW-02.steps:
1. POST /training/records (3 h, activity type requiring evidence)
2. POST /training/records/{id}/evidences (multipart PNG)
3. GET /training/records/{id}/evidences
4. POST /training/records/{id}/submit
5. GET /training/status/me
L3-FLOW-02.expected:
After 1: 200, workflowStatus DRAFT
After 2: 200, moderationStatus PASSED, object in storage
After 3: at least one evidence row listed
After 4: workflowStatus SUBMITTED
After 5: submittedHours = 3.0 for the caller
L3-FLOW-02.notes: SC-01 end to end over HTTP: only SUBMITTED records count toward compliance hours
L3-FLOW-02.block: FLOW-02: CME evidence submission (SC-01)  |  create → evidence → submit → hours counted

L3-FLOW-03.steps:
1. POST /forms
2. POST /forms/{id}/versions (1 scored question)
3. POST .../publication
4. POST /form-assignments {managerId, formVersionIds}
5. GET /assigned-forms (as the assignee)
6. POST /form-submissions {assignmentItemId, subject}
7. PUT /form-submissions/{id} (answers)
8. POST /form-submissions/{id}/submission
9. GET /forms/{id}/versions/{vid}/responses (as ADMIN)
L3-FLOW-03.expected:
After 1: 201 DRAFT
After 2: 201 versionNumber 1
After 3: 200 PUBLISHED
After 4: 201 with one assignment item
After 5: the item appears for the assignee
After 6: 201 DRAFT / NOT_CONFIGURED
After 7: 200, lockVersion bumped
After 8: SUBMITTED + CALCULATED
After 9: the response body contains the assignee's employee code
L3-FLOW-03.notes: Nine HTTP calls across four controllers and three roles
L3-FLOW-03.block: FLOW-03: Checklist build → assign → submit → read (SC-02)

L3-FLOW-04.steps:
1. POST /questions
2. POST /question-sets + /activate
3. POST /exam-configs + /activate
4. POST /exam-papers/generate
5. POST /exam-papers/{id}/publish
6. POST /exam-assignments + /open
7. POST /me/exam-assignments/{id}/start
8. POST /me/exam-attempts/{id}/submit
9. GET /me/exam-attempts
L3-FLOW-04.expected:
After 1: question APPROVED
After 2: set ACTIVE, questionCount 1
After 3: config ACTIVE
After 4: one paper generated with question snapshots
After 5: paper PUBLISHED
After 6: assignment OPEN, targetCount 1
After 7: attempt IN_PROGRESS with expiresAt
After 8: attempt GRADED with passed = true
After 9: the attempt is listed as GRADED
L3-FLOW-04.notes: The full evaluation pipeline through the API only — no repository writes, unlike the L2 fixture that had to seed snapshots directly
L3-FLOW-04.block: FLOW-04: Exam lifecycle (SC-03)  |  question → set → config → paper → assignment → attempt → grade

L3-FLOW-05.expected:
After 1: 200, both tokens issued
After 2: 200
After 3: 200, refresh token revoked
After 4: 401 AUTH_001 "Token đã bị thu hồi"
After 5: still 200 — the access token remains valid for its remaining lifetime
L3-FLOW-05.notes: Not a defect but a contract clients must know: sessions are stateless with no access-token blacklist, so logout only stops renewal. Exposure window = the 15-minute access-token TTL
L3-FLOW-05.block: FLOW-05: Logout semantics (negative)  |  revocation covers refresh only

sheets.name: L3-Performance
sheets.title: L3-Performance  |  k6 Load + Stress Tests  |  NFR-P01, NFR-S01, NFR-P02 (TDS 7.4)

L3-PERF-01.config:
stages:
  0 → 300 VUs in 60s (ramp-up)
  300 VUs for 5 min (steady)
  300 → 0 in 30s
L3-PERF-01.auth: Each VU logs in once via POST /auth/login and reuses the access token (scripts/k6/lib/auth.js);\ncodes from K6_EMPLOYEE_CODES, password from K6_PASSWORD
L3-PERF-01.notes: scripts/k6/load-nfr-p01.js — NOT RUN: needs k6 installed plus the app on a real PostgreSQL. Baseline/Actual stay empty until the first run
L3-PERF-01.block: Block: Load Tests — verify NFR thresholds at the expected peak

L3-PERF-02.config:
stages:
  0 → 500 VUs in 120s (ramp-up)
  500 VUs for 10 min (steady)
  500 → 0 in 60s
L3-PERF-02.auth: Same JWT pool as PERF-01; one login per VU
L3-PERF-02.threshold: server_errors_5xx count == 0 (graceful degradation, not failure)\nhttp_req_failed rate < 0.01\nhttp_req_duration p(99) < 10000ms

sheets.name: L3-Security
sheets.title: L3-Security  |  OWASP Top 10: A01 Access Control, A02 Cryptographic Failures, A03 Injection, A05 Misconfiguration, A07 Auth Failures, A09 Logging

L3-SEC-01.vector: Horizontal privilege escalation: employee B reads employee A's CME record by guessing its id
L3-SEC-01.safeResponse: HTTP 403 with error_code AUTH_002\nthe body contains neither A's employee code nor the record title
L3-SEC-01.notes: Ownership is enforced in TrainingAccessPolicy, not only in the query

L3-SEC-02.vector: Vertical privilege escalation: a plain USER calls the admin surface
L3-SEC-02.payload: GET /api/v1/users and GET /api/v1/dashboard/overview with a USER token
L3-SEC-02.safeResponse: HTTP 403 with error_code AUTH_002 on both\nno employee list and no aggregate figures in either body
L3-SEC-02.notes: @PreAuthorize is evaluated by method security, so the handler never runs

L3-SEC-03.vector: Credential exposure: does any response echo a password, and is the stored value hashed?
L3-SEC-03.tool: REST Assured equivalent (JUnit 5 + real HTTP) + direct DB read
L3-SEC-03.payload: POST /api/v1/users (admin creates an account), then GET /api/v1/me
L3-SEC-03.safeResponse: Neither body contains "password" or a "$2a$" hash\nDB: users.password starts with $2a$ (BCrypt)
L3-SEC-03.notes: The generated first-login password travels by email only, never in the HTTP response

L3-SEC-04.vector: Token forgery: edit the JWT payload so roles claims ADMIN, keep the original signature
L3-SEC-04.payload: GET /api/v1/users with a token whose base64url payload was rewritten ("USER" → "ADMIN") and the signature left untouched
L3-SEC-04.safeResponse: HTTP 401 with an empty body and WWW-Authenticate: Bearer\nno privilege gain — the request never reaches the controller
L3-SEC-04.notes: Only a real HTTP test can prove this: MockMvc's jwt() post-processor never invokes NimbusJwtDecoder, so signature verification is untested at L1/L2

L3-SEC-05.vector: SQL injection through a filter parameter
L3-SEC-05.payload: GET /api/v1/users?keyword=' OR 1=1--  (URL-encoded) with an ADMIN token
L3-SEC-05.safeResponse: HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content array — the payload is matched as a literal string\nno "SQL" or "Exception" text in the body; the users table is intact
L3-SEC-05.notes: JPA parameter binding; the payload never reaches the SQL grammar

L3-SEC-06.vector: Injection through the Spring Data sort parameter (a classic property-path pivot)
L3-SEC-06.safeResponse: 4xx/5xx without executing anything: no "org.hibernate" or "at vn.vietduc" in the body, and the users row count is unchanged
L3-SEC-06.notes: The sort whitelist (see L3-TRN-02) is what blocks this — endpoints without a whitelist would be worth re-testing

L3-SEC-07.vector: Credential stuffing: 20 consecutive failed logins against one account
L3-SEC-07.payload: POST /api/v1/auth/login × 20 with wrong passwords, then once with the correct password
L3-SEC-07.safeResponse: Every attempt answers the same 400 REQ_001 — and that is the finding: no 423/429, no counter, no delay, and the correct password still works immediately
L3-SEC-07.notes: D38: no rate limiting and no lockout anywhere in the app (only manual PATCH /users/{id}/lock). /auth/forgot-password and /user/first-login/send-email-otp are equally unthrottled

L3-SEC-08.vector: Error hygiene and traceability: does a handled error leak internals, and can a client trace be joined to the server log?
L3-SEC-08.payload: GET /api/v1/training/records/99999999, then the same request with X-Correlation-ID: l3-trace-42
L3-SEC-08.safeResponse: 404 SYS_404 with a correlation id header and no stack trace, class name or SQL fragment in the body\nan inbound X-Correlation-ID is echoed unchanged
L3-SEC-08.notes: Caveat: authentication failures bypass this handler entirely, so 401 responses carry no correlation id (D36)

L3-SEC-09.vector: Security misconfiguration: active ZAP scan plus transport hardening (HTTPS redirect, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP)
L3-SEC-09.payload: zap-cli active-scan against the deployed base URL, then inspect the response headers of any endpoint over TLS
L3-SEC-09.safeResponse: No high-risk ZAP alerts; HSTS present; no security-header findings; TLS 1.2+ only
L3-SEC-09.notes: BLOCKED: no ZAP in this environment and the test server speaks plain HTTP, so neither the scan nor the header set can be asserted. The test exists with @Disabled carrying this reason. Also worth checking there: app.cors.allowed-origin-patterns defaults to "*" while allowCredentials(true) — safe in configured environments, dangerous if the property is ever unset
